text:
ops-bot: INCIDENT ALERT - High tail latency on inference.prod (p95 > 1.2s) — paging oncall
alyssa: saw the page, jumping in. any customer-facing errors? :eyes:
chris: Not seeing 5xxs in the API gateway, but a spike in token-generation time from the runtime nodes.
maria: I can look at the model pool, will run `rts inspect --pool inference-prod` and post results.
alyssa: assigning primary -> @chris, secondary -> @maria for the next hour. jon you on standby? pls ack.
jon: acked. available.
chris: i'm tailing runtime logs. noticing GC spikes on node-gpu-12 and one pod OOM killed yesterday but came back
maria: pool status: 3/12 nodes showing high CUDA utilization, one node (gpu-12) has frequent kernel timeouts. linking runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency-investigation
maria: runbook cmd snippet:
```
# check kvcache hit rate
rts metrics query "kvcache.hit_rate{service=inference-prod}"
```
alyssa: customer impact: we have scattered slow responses for a small percentage (~2%) of requests; no error rate increase. flagging for SL team FYI.
ops-bot: Deploy bot: canary rollout started for model-v2.3 on inference-prod (deploy id d-7781)
chris: deploy might be contributing. can we rollback the canary? I don't see regressions on v2.3 in perf tests but real traffic shows tail issues.
maria: proposing temporary mitigation: exclude gpu-12 from routing and scale up 2 additional nodes. quick commands:
```
kubectl cordon node-gpu-12
rts scale --pool inference-prod --replicas +2
```
jon: scaling now, cordon applied.
chris: scaling took effect, pods in Pending->Running. removed node-gpu-12 from LB.
alyssa: nice. monitoring p95.
ops-bot: Alert resolved: p95 returned to baseline after scale and cordon (automated check passed)
chris: latency back to expected range. leaving primary on @chris until handoff.
maria: filed follow-up ticket INF-2487: "Investigate kernel timeouts on gpu-12 and improve node-level isolation" — assigned to infra-team. link: https://redwood.internal/tickets/INF-2487
alyssa: post-handoff plan: i take primary at 08:00 UTC handoff. @chris please summarize quick notes for next oncall.
chris: notes for handoff: root cause unknown, probable combination of node-level driver/kernel instability + canary traffic. mitigations applied: cordon gpu-12, +2 replicas, halted further canary ramp. tickets:
- INF-2487 (infra) — investigate gpu kernel timeouts
- INF-2488 (runtime) — add more aggressive prefix caching for model-v2.x to reduce compute
- INF-2489 (alerts) — tune p95 alert threshold to use smoothed metric (avoid flapping)
jon: scheduling 30m postmortem sync tomorrow 09:00 UTC. i've created calendar invite and retrospective doc: https://redwood.internal/pm/retros/INF-2487
maria: action items I took:
- collected `dmesg` and nvml logs from gpu-12 -> uploaded to ticket INF-2487
- added temporary LB rule to avoid gpu-12
chris: also adding a follow-up to test canary ramping strategy on low-latency paths. INF-2490 created.
alyssa: thanks team. final checklist before handoff:
- confirm no outstanding pages (ops-bot said resolved)
- confirm tickets created and assigned (INF-2487..INF-2490)
- ensure oncall runbook link in doc and escalation path noted
chris: confirmed.
jon: confirmed.
alyssa: handing off primary to @maria at 08:00 UTC. i'll remain reachable for 1hr after.
maria: acknowledged. will monitor and follow up on INF-2487. retrospective sync added to calendar.
ops-bot: REMINDER: please complete the post-incident timeline in the incident tracker: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1865432109
alyssa: added timeline and initial impact estimate (2% of requests affected, estimated 8m median additional latency for affected requests). will expand in the ticket.
maria: noted action owners on INF-2487 and INF-2489. assigning myself to infra triage for next 48h.
jon: leaving final note: consider automating node cordon when kernel timeouts exceed threshold (runbook idea). adding to INF-2491.
alyssa: thanks all. closing thread, see you on the retro. :thumbsup:
